```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  id="definitions"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn">

  <!-- Collaboration and pool -->
  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="OrgPool" name="Organisation" processRef="Process_1"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <!-- Process -->
  <bpmn:process id="Process_1" isExecutable="false">

    <!-- Lanes -->
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Org">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_MPNO" name="MPON">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_1</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyMPOO</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FinalReading_MPNO</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DismountOld_MPNO</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_MountNew</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReadMeter</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendValuesToGO</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TellGO</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>

      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_MPOO" name="MPOO">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AnnounceSelf</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyNoSelf</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FinalReading_MPOO</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DismountOld_MPOO</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>

      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_GO" name="GO">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyMSP</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>

      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_MSP" name="MSP"/>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <!-- Start event -->
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_1" name="Process start"/>

    <!-- Tasks -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NotifyMPOO" name="Notify MPOO about equipment change intentions"/>
    
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AnnounceSelf" name="Announce self dismounting to MPON"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NotifyNoSelf" name="Notify MPON about no self‑dismounting of MPOO"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_FinalReading_MPNO" name="Perform final reading"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FinalReading_MPOO" name="Perform final reading"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_DismountOld_MPNO" name="Dismount old equipment"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DismountOld_MPOO" name="Dismount old equipment"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_MountNew" name="Mount new device"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReadMeter" name="Read meter count from installed meter"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendValuesToGO" name="Send final reading values to GO"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TellGO" name="Tell GO about device changes, master data and meter count at installation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NotifyMSP" name="Notify MSP about device changes, master data, meter count at dismounting and installation"/>

    <!-- End event -->
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_1" name="Process end"/>

    <!-- Gateways -->
    <!-- 1. MPOO decision -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MPOO_Decision" name="MPOO decision"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MPOO_Merge" name="MPOO merge"/>

    <!-- 2. Performer of final reading -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FinalReading_Decision" name="Who performs final reading?"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FinalReading_Merge" name="Final reading merge"/>

    <!-- 3. Performer of dismount -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Dismount_Decision" name="Who dismounts old equipment?"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Dismount_Merge" name="Dismount merge"/>

    <!-- Sequence flows -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_0" sourceRef="StartEvent_1" targetRef="Task_NotifyMPOO"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="Task_NotifyMPOO" targetRef="Gateway_MPOO_Decision"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2a" sourceRef="Gateway_MPOO_Decision" targetRef="Task_AnnounceSelf" name="self dismounting"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2b" sourceRef="Gateway_MPOO_Decision" targetRef="Task_NotifyNoSelf" name="no self dismounting"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3a" sourceRef="Task_AnnounceSelf" targetRef="Gateway_MPOO_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3b" sourceRef="Task_NotifyNoSelf" targetRef="Gateway_MPOO_Merge"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Gateway_MPOO_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_FinalReading_Decision"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5a" sourceRef="Gateway_FinalReading_Decision" targetRef="Task_FinalReading_MPNO" name="MPON"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5b" sourceRef="Gateway_FinalReading_Decision" targetRef="Task_FinalReading_MPOO" name="MPOO"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6a" sourceRef="Task_FinalReading_MPNO" targetRef="Gateway_FinalReading_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6b" sourceRef="Task_FinalReading_MPOO" targetRef="Gateway_FinalReading_Merge"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Gateway_FinalReading_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Dismount_Decision"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8a" sourceRef="Gateway_Dismount_Decision" targetRef="Task_DismountOld_MPNO" name="MPON"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8b" sourceRef="Gateway_Dismount_Decision" targetRef="Task_DismountOld_MPOO" name="MPOO"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9a" sourceRef="Task_DismountOld_MPNO" targetRef="Gateway_Dismount_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9b" sourceRef="Task_DismountOld_MPOO" targetRef="Gateway_Dismount_Merge"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Gateway_Dismount_Merge" targetRef="Task_MountNew"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_MountNew" targetRef="Task_ReadMeter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_ReadMeter" targetRef="Task_SendValuesToGO"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_SendValuesToGO" targetRef="Task_TellGO"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_TellGO" targetRef="Task_NotifyMSP"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_NotifyMSP" targetRef="EndEvent_1"/>

  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
```

We need to model described process. Need one pool for organisation (presumably containing the actors MPON, MPOO, GO, MSP). Actually may be external parties? The description: MPON, MPOO, GO, MSP. Probably all part of organisation? Use pool with lanes for each actor. We'll create lanes: MPON, MPOO, GO, MSP. Use tasks as names.

Let's parse steps:

1. "The MPON notifies the MPOO about equipment change intentions." => Task: "Notify MPOO about equipment change intentions" performed by MPON.

2. "The MPOO announces self dismounting to the MPON or the MPOO shall notify the MPON about no self-dismounting of the MPOO." => Decision: MPOO either announces self dismounting to MPON, or notifies MPON about no self-dismounting. So after step 1, we have exclusive gateway with two branches:

   a) Task: "Announce self dismounting to MPON" performed by MPOO.

   b) Task: "Notify MPON about no self-dismounting of MPOO" performed by MPOO.

3. "The MPON or the MPOO perform the final reading." So after each branch, we have exclusive gateway? Actually it's: whichever of MPON or MPOO performs final reading. Could model as exclusive gateway with two tasks: "Perform final reading" by MPON or "Perform final reading" by MPOO. Could combine? But to keep clear, have exclusive gateway leading to two tasks: "Perform final reading (MPON)" and "Perform final reading (MPOO)". Or we can model as parallel? It says "or". So exclusive.

4. "The MPON or the MPOO dismount the old equipment." Similarly exclusive: two tasks "Dismount old equipment (MPON)" and "Dismount old equipment (MPOO)". Possibly same actor that performed final reading continues? Not specified, but we can have another exclusive gateway after final reading leading to dismount tasks.

5. "The MPON mounts the new device." Task performed by MPON.

6. "The MPON reads the meter count from the installed meter." Task performed by MPON.

7. "The MPON sents the values of the final reading to the GO." (typo "sents") Task performed by MPON: "Send final reading values to GO".

8. "The MPON tells the GO about the device changes, the master data and the meter count at installation." Task performed by MPON: "Tell GO about device changes, master data and meter count at installation".

Probably steps 7 and 8 could be combined, but we will keep separate.

9. "The GO shall notify the MSP about the device changes, the master data, the meter count at dismounting, and the meter count at installation." Task performed by GO: "Notify MSP about device changes, master data, meter count at dismounting, and meter count at installation".

Sequence: start -> MPON notify MPOO -> exclusive gateway for MPOO decision -> two branches lead to final reading (by MPON or MPOO). After final reading, dismount old equipment (by MPON or MPOO). After dismount, MPON mounts new device (task). Then MPON reads meter count. Then MPON sends final reading values to GO. Then MPON tells GO about changes. Then GO notifies MSP. Then end.

We need parallel? Not needed.

All activities are tasks. Use exclusive gateways for decisions and also for the "MPON or MPOO" choices. We'll have separate exclusive gateways with two outgoing branches.

We need to marry flows: after each exclusive decision, we may need to merge before continuing. So after the MPOO decision (announce or notify), both branches converge before final reading? The description: after MPOO announces self dismounting or notifies about no self-dismounting, the final reading is performed by MPON or MPOO. This likely independent of which path taken. So will merge after MPOO decision.

Thus:

- G1 (exclusive) after MPON notifies MPOO leads to task A (announce self) and task B (notify no self). Then both converge at G1_merge (exclusive join?) Actually we can use exclusive gateway (join) or parallel? Since branches are mutually exclusive, they can join with exclusive gateway (or just a simple gateway). Use exclusive gateway as join (same type). So after both tasks converge to a merge (exclusive gateway) leading to next exclusive gateway for performer of final reading.

Similarly after final reading tasks, merge then exclusive for dismount performer, then merge then continue.
